title: Team model: create, join and invite codes
agent_directive: This JSON is the complete task spec. First read docs/prompts/_standards.json once, then load the skills in `skills`. Read only the `spec_sections` of docs/fypms-docs.md (grep the FR id; never open the whole file). Build only what `build` lists and reply with `reply_format` from _standards.json.
build: models/team (schema, repo) and src/lib/teams/create-team-tx.ts: createTeamInTx(tx, {leaderUid, memberUids, courseId, yearId, name}) reusable by auto-group (04-03). It increments counters/{courseId}.next_sequence, builds group_number with formatGroupNumber, creates the team (status formation, max_members 5), members docs, invite_codes/{code} via tx.create and teams/{id}/private/invite.
src/lib/teams/invite-code.ts (pure + injectable RNG): 6 uppercase alphanumerics excluding 0, O, 1, I; collision retry up to 5 times.

src/app/actions/create-team.ts: student only; transaction checks (a) caller not on an active team in the current year, (b) course_id comes from the caller's users.profile.course_id (never from input). Input: team name.

src/app/actions/join-team.ts: input invite code; resolve invite_codes/{code}; transaction checks course match (409 with the exact spec message), not already on a team this year, member_count < max_members, team status formation or topic_pending. Update member_ids, member_count, members doc; writeAudit; notify the leader (team_update).
Server tests: course mismatch 409, full team, double membership, five parallel creates in one course produce five unique sequential group numbers, invite-code collision retry, prefix derivation.
rules: Invite code is never stored on the team document
group_number prefix is derived from team.course_id, never from input
stretch_optional: invite-member action: leader invites a classmate by index number or email (same course, not on a team) and the invitee gets a team_invite notification with the code
acceptance: A mismatched-programme join returns 409 with the spec message
Concurrent creation never duplicates a group number
